name: Hans-Rudolf Keller
bio:
Hans-Rudolf's precision engineering skills were honed in the Swiss watchmaking industry before a lifelong passion for motorsport led him to a career change in his late 20s. He started in a small rally team, building roll cages and suspension components, quickly earning a reputation for meticulousness and reliability. He joined Prema Racing fifteen years ago. 

Hans-Rudolf's approach to fabrication is characterized by a deep understanding of material properties and a commitment to achieving the highest tolerances. He believes in a hands-on approach, preferring the feel of metal and the challenge of problem-solving in the workshop. His experience with a wide range of fabrication techniques, from traditional machining to modern composite layup, makes him a versatile and valuable asset to the team. His ability to 'MacGyver' solutions to unexpected mechanical challenges is legendary within Prema.

While not the most outgoing member of the team, Hans-Rudolf is deeply respected for his unwavering dedication and the quiet confidence he exudes in his craft. He is a true craftsman, driven by a desire to create components that are not only functional but also works of art.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Hans-Rudolf is of average height with a slightly stocky build, reflecting years spent hunched over machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when working on components designed in imperial units.
Has a small collection of vintage watchmaking tools he uses for fine detail work.
